items.title: Arnold Loyacano Interview, 1956-09-29
items.q: So, we saw Mr. Schultz. I'm pretty sure that was his name manager. Then we told him what we had. He said, all right. He said, I'll tell you what I'll do. He said, I'll give you boys a contract for two weeks and $25 a man a week.

ctx.x: And, uh, Sophie Tucker was working upstairs. Mm-hmm. It was so big that it had a terrace around it. Mm-hmm. On the, uh, two-story. Mm-hmm. So, we saw Mr. Schultz. I'm pretty sure that was his name manager. Then we told him what we had. He said, all right. He said, I'll tell you what I'll do. He said, I'll give you boys a contract for two weeks and $25 a man a week. But after the money we're getting in Chicago, that was peanuts.
